title: NeuroPulse: Edge Health Telemetry & Anomaly Detection
summary: Real-time edge computing system utilizing 1D-CNN and LSTM networks to detect cardiac arrhythmias and anomalous physiological patterns from wearable PPG sensor streams.

title: Aether-RAG: Multimodal Campus Intelligence Engine
summary: An enterprise-grade hybrid retrieval-augmented generation engine indexing 10,000+ academic papers, course syllabi, and administrative documents for VIT Pune students.

title: VisionFlow: Autonomous Traffic & Infrastructure Analytics
summary: Scalable urban mobility surveillance framework with automated vehicle tracking, lane violation detection, and real-time congestion heatmapping using YOLOv11 and DeepSORT.

title: AlphaStream: High-Throughput Financial Backtester
summary: Low-latency algorithmic backtesting engine written in Rust and Python with support for order-book simulation, risk parity attribution, and automated strategy optimization.

title: DataSphere: Open Academic Dataset Exchange
summary: Decentralized, version-controlled open data repository platform allowing student researchers to publish, cite, and benchmark local dataset splits with automated SHA-256 validation.
